description: This file defines interfaces for managing UBUS context within the BBFDM project, including initialization, cleanup, synchronous and asynchronous invocation of UBUS methods, and event sending. It primarily contains type definitions, function declarations, and macro helpers for UBUS operations.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_ubus_ctx
methods.description: Initializes the UBUS context within a given BBFDM context.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_ubus_ctx
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the UBUS context in a given BBFDM context.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_invoke_sync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous invocation of a UBUS method, executing a callback with the response.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_invoke_async
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous invocation of a UBUS method, with callback handling for response and completion.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_send_event
methods.description: Sends an event message to a specified UBUS object.

ctags.name: bbfdm_ubus_cb
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*bbfdm_ubus_cb)(struct ubus_request *req, int type, struct blob_attr *msg);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(struct ubus_request * req,int type,struct blob_attr * msg)
